relationshipTypes.label: Extends
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity builds upon the target entity while preserving its core idea.

canonicalDirection.description: The source builds upon the target with additional capability or scope.

relationshipTypes.label: Specializes
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity is a more specific form of the target entity.

canonicalDirection.description: The source narrows or specializes the concept represented by the target.

inverse.description: The inverse states that the target generalizes the source.

relationshipTypes.label: Generalizes
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity is a broader abstraction of the target entity.

canonicalDirection.description: The source abstracts over the more specific target entity.

inverse.description: The inverse states that the target specializes the source.

relationshipTypes.label: Belongs To
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity is a member of the target taxonomy, family, or category.

canonicalDirection.description: The source is classified as belonging to the target category.

relationshipTypes.label: Part Of
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity is a component, step, or member part of the target entity.

canonicalDirection.description: The source is contained within or composes part of the target.

inverse.description: The inverse states that the target contains the source.

relationshipTypes.label: Contains
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity contains the target entity as a component, step, or member part.

canonicalDirection.description: The source contains the target as one of its constituent parts.

inverse.description: The inverse states that the target is part of the source.

relationshipTypes.label: Requires
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the target entity is a mandatory dependency for the source entity to function as defined.

canonicalDirection.description: The source requires the target as a necessary dependency.

relationshipTypes.label: Depends On
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates a conceptual, operational, or indirect dependency from the source entity to the target entity.

canonicalDirection.description: The source depends on the target without necessarily making it mandatory.

relationshipTypes.label: Uses
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity uses the target entity without specifying whether usage is mandatory.

canonicalDirection.description: The source uses the target as part of its behavior, design, or operation.

relationshipTypes.label: Optionally Uses
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity may optionally use the target entity without requiring it.

canonicalDirection.description: The source can use the target, but the target is not mandatory.

relationshipTypes.label: Consumes
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity receives or consumes the target entity as an input.

canonicalDirection.description: The source consumes the target as input during operation.

relationshipTypes.label: Produces
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity creates, emits, or produces the target entity as an output.

canonicalDirection.description: The source produces the target as an output or result.

relationshipTypes.label: Transforms

canonicalDirection.description: The source transforms the target as part of a process.

relationshipTypes.label: Implements
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity realizes the target concept, abstraction, component, or technique.

canonicalDirection.description: The source provides a concrete realization of the target.

relationshipTypes.label: Supports
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity supports the target capability, entity, or compatibility scenario.

canonicalDirection.description: The source provides support for the target capability or entity.

relationshipTypes.label: Provides
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity offers the target component, feature, service, model, or resource.

canonicalDirection.description: The source offers or makes the target available.

relationshipTypes.label: Integrates With
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity has an integration relationship with the target system or component.

canonicalDirection.description: The source integrates with the target system, service, or component.

relationshipTypes.label: Exposes
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity exposes the target interface, capability, abstraction, or endpoint.

canonicalDirection.description: The source makes the target interface or capability available.

relationshipTypes.label: Introduces

canonicalDirection.description: The source is the origin that introduced the target.

evidenceRequirement.description: Introduction claims should cite the original paper, documentation, or source.

relationshipTypes.label: Describes
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity explains or describes the target entity.

canonicalDirection.description: The source contains explanatory knowledge about the target.

relationshipTypes.label: Defines

canonicalDirection.description: The source gives the canonical definition for the target.

relationshipTypes.label: References
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source entity has a general reference to the target entity or source.

canonicalDirection.description: The source refers to the target without asserting a narrower citation relationship.

relationshipTypes.label: Cites

canonicalDirection.description: The source cites the target as a formal citation or source reference.

relationshipTypes.label: Authored By

canonicalDirection.description: The source was authored by the target.

cardinality.description: Authored entities normally have at least one author.

relationshipTypes.label: Published In
relationshipTypes.description: Indicates that the source publication appeared in the target venue or publication context.

canonicalDirection.description: The source was published in the target venue.

relationshipTypes.label: Inspired By

canonicalDirection.description: The source draws conceptual inspiration from the target.

relationshipTypes.label: Evaluated By

canonicalDirection.description: The source is evaluated by the target.

inverse.description: The inverse states that the target evaluates the source.

relationshipTypes.label: Validates

canonicalDirection.description: The source validates or confirms the target.

relationshipTypes.label: Benchmarked By

relationshipTypes.label: Compatible With

canonicalDirection.description: The source is compatible with the target in an applicable context.

relationshipTypes.label: Incompatible With

canonicalDirection.description: The source is incompatible with the target in an applicable context.

relationshipTypes.label: Alternative To

relationshipTypes.label: Complements

canonicalDirection.description: The source complements the target when used together.

inverse.description: The inverse states that the target supersedes the source.

inverse.description: The inverse states that the target precedes the source.

canonicalDirection.description: The source causes or initiates the target.

relationshipTypes.label: Branches To

canonicalDirection.description: The source directly solves the target problem.

evidenceRequirement.description: Strong solution claims should be backed by evidence or explicit rationale.
